title: Spine entity
decision_summary: Hybrid: L2 tasks + L3 role profiles are the spine; typed L1 competencies are first-class assessable packages that must link to tasks (to critical tasks for selection use); users enter via roles/competencies; links stored once on the many side.
dissent_summary: IA: NLP should target competencies until L2 is richer (handled in DP-18); FH: users touch competencies (accepted as packaging); CM: SME burden of task bundles (depth over breadth).

title: Top-level organization
decision_summary: Retire v1 domains/skill areas as top level (kept as legacy alias facet); organize by orthogonal L0 facets on tasks (work function, subsector, competency type, reusability, crafts, workflow profile; authority position and sector actor on role variants); modules are the stewardship unit; users navigate by role family and work function.
dissent_summary: None on substance; LC/FH asked for legacy domain navigation (granted). Trade-off: more facets to tag reliably (IO).

title: Typing rules and grain
decision_summary: Eight entity kinds (practice competency, knowledge area, transversal practice, task, knowledge statement, L4 tool/method/standard, L5 instrument, credential); DC-R1-R5 adopted for all crafts plus FC tools-vs-bundle test, instrument-vs-tool rule and credentials-as-gates; grain rules G-1..G-9 (task links, single-verb tasks, production vs review split, three-module core rule, no-defining-craft allowed, small business/funding practice cluster, core 120-180).
dissent_summary: PS: role profiles must query named tools (accepted via L4 links); DC vs SC on where policy instruments live (resolved by kind); FH wants statute-specific anchors in federal variants (adopted).

title: Proficiency model
decision_summary: Generic L1-L5 responsibility scale (Supervised, Independent, Senior, Lead/Expert, Strategic) on IO's seven attributes incl. augmented practice and formation of others; Awareness is a knowledge bundle, not a level; level spans with IO publication rules; L5 only where SMEs confirm; 2-5 indicators per level with augmentation_mode/use_class; years descriptive only; OPM, grade, licensure and 4-level drafts mapped in L6.
dissent_summary: FH wanted Awareness as level 1 (handled as crosswalk offset); LC prefers 3 trainable + recognized Expert (kept as training view); DC/SC/FC drafted 4 levels (mapped L1-L4). L5 provisional on job-analysis data.

title: Craft representation
decision_summary: v2 definitions (FC incl. engineered systems; DC warrant-based, five functions; SC four-property deliverable, SC1-SC9); per-task 0/1/2 ordinal per craft by blind multi-rater coding, plus field_dependency and formation_dependency and reproduction-regime attributes; swappable scale; blends computed (importance x time share); dominant craft display-only; blends describe/design, not mobility similarity; IO pilot decides scale.
dissent_summary: IO: ordinal not inherently more reliable (scale provisional pending pilot); FC may contest broadening to engineered systems (DB); DC/FC monitoring-design ownership resolved by allowing both at 2.

title: Role grain and first role set
decision_summary: Stored grain = function-defined role profile x role level (bands of L1-L5) with sector-actor variants; separate role only if licence defines scope or core-task overlap < 0.60; FH's series x grade band is a generated Federal Series Profile view (and state class views likewise); 37 roles in 4 tiers: 13 corridor roles (3 corridors), 17 federal/state design-partner roles covering FH's 13 series and SL's 12, 6 emerging what's-coming roles, 1 sector-extension.
dissent_summary: FH: series x grade band is the federal unit of use (met by generated view, not grain); SL: authority position as second key (made a required variant attribute); CP: 12-15 roles only (met by tiered depth). Series statuses provisional: OPM consolidation only proposed.

title: Sector actors and the Tribal boundary
decision_summary: Seven sector actors with subtypes (TN's Tribal subtypes); industry/ownership/delivery model orthogonal (utility and consulting are not actors); structured enactment records by default, actor-specific competencies only when deliverable differs in kind (4 authorized); obligations owed to Tribal nations are core Statecraft content; TN's five vetoes adopted as schema/CI invariants; interim content hold on all Tribal-related content; reserved Tribally stewarded namespace; recommend binding TAC + charter carve-out. Project lead accepted Q1 (binding TAC consent authority, charter carve-out with withhold default, compensation before first contact) on 2026-10-23; content hold stays until a Council constituted by Tribal governments and inter-Tribal organizations exists; an invitation to help form the TAC is project-lead question Q11 (default: none drafted for sending).
dissent_summary: CA's own 'context not content' hypothesis amended for Tribal obligations (larger core); LM/IA accept a Tribal measurement gap; TAC binding authority and charter carve-out require project lead; all Tribal content needs real consultation.

title: Exposure and change model
decision_summary: Per-task dated, attributed ExposureAssessment records (text-hash pinned) on three constructs never fused: technical exposure by vector (llm/robotics/sensing/convergent), deployment mode + adoption strategy, and outcome (role-level staffing; scenario SC1-SC4 rows only above threshold); codebook v2 rules XR-01..07 (blind coding, Ac=time compression, S/V gated on deployment, governed-data rule); ingest Eloundou, AEI, Microsoft, BLS AI exposure categories, OMB inventory; v1 values prior evidence only; CLD/entry-path health/robustness computed.
dissent_summary: LM wants components shown vs HR one label (resolved: headline + drill-down); FC loses quotable 'Human-Essential'; DC: usage indices under-measure environmental ML (sensing tracker added). Index ingest provisional on curated O*NET task crosswalk.

title: Governance, federation, cadence (part a)
decision_summary: Adopt AS charter (Steward, Editorial Board, TSC, Advisory Council, Tribal Council with consent authority, Module Stewards, Validation Panels, Sentinel Network) plus Workforce Voice Panel with G1 usefulness veto (written-override procedure); phased federation (editorial sections centrally authored 2027-28; stewarded modules after agreement + 2 on-time cycles; orphan clause); typed PR change process with two-source evidence rule; PATCH as needed/crosswalks quarterly, MINOR each April, MAJOR <= every 3 years with 12-month notice, 24-month support; anti-ASC succession and 3-FTE floor; recommend EPIC incubation to Dec 2027 then university host.
dissent_summary: IO vs AS on adopter-recruited panels (IO composition rules apply); university vs society host; fee-for-service neutrality. Host/EPIC confirmation is the project lead's.

title: IDs, canonical serialization, versioning
decision_summary: Canonical editable source = per-entity YAML (+JSONL for volume records, SSSOM TSV for mappings) in DE's layout, using IA's entity model and JSON-LD term names under ONE schema hardened with DE's invariants; JSON-LD bundle is the generated normative release serialization. IDs: IA's form emst:<namespace>/<TYPE>-<6 base32+Luhn check> on w3id, namespace = minting authority; DE's minting (random CSPRNG, single writer, append-only registry, minted only at candidate; seed: keys before). One taxonomy SemVer + dated fast-layer snapshots + versioned crosswalk sets; no per-concept SemVer.
dissent_summary: IA preferred JSON-LD bundle as canonical store, deterministic migration minting and per-layer/per-concept SemVer (rejected for reviewability and simplicity; semantics kept). DE's lowercase short IDs replaced by IA's check-symbol form.

title: v1 dispositions
decision_summary: Carry the ideas, re-derive the structure, migrate all 222 competencies and 666 tasks as seed records with provenance (copyB baseline; source text outranks DB for content; v1 tags prior evidence only; stored summaries not migrated); per-competency decisions (carry/rewrite/split/merge/retire/move-to-tools/move-to-module/hold-for-tribal-review) in v1_disposition.csv; element-level register finalized in ADR table.
dissent_summary: Minor: FC retires none of its 49; DC retires 7 of 35 D2 - followed, with merges across lanes. Trade-off: honest smaller v2.0 vs continuity of v1 counts/narratives.

title: No personal data; four-tier architecture
decision_summary: Binding invariants: I-1 the EMST steward holds no person-level data (no person entity; de-identified signals; pseudonymous raters, aggregate-only panel data; observed transitions only as n>=5 aggregates; consented records with an IRB research partner) and I-2 development use only (never ranks/screens people). Four tiers: open core; static local-first explorer; adopter-run kits; no hosted personnel service.
dissent_summary: CM: validation needs career histories (aggregates + research-partner custody); CP no telemetry slows causal evidence; IA inference deferred in favour of anchored self/supervisor rating.

title: Licensing
decision_summary: CC0 1.0 for all EMST-authored data and standard text (vocab, schema, IDs, competency/task/role text, crosswalks, views, SPEC); CC BY 4.0 for narrative publications (flagship report, decks, briefs); Apache-2.0 code; DCO; provenance via release ID/DOI stamps, CITATION.cff and EMST marks held in trust with conformance policy; third-party text excluded (IDs only); Tribal-contributed content in own namespace/licence, excluded from bulk CC0 unless opted in. Conditional on lead's CC0 dedication of v1-derived content.
dissent_summary: AS dissents: CC BY 4.0 for content text would strengthen provenance and fundability; CA judges marks + DOI + conformance convention capture most of that without embedding friction or two licences per record.

title: Rollout sequencing
decision_summary: Parallel tracks: Stage 1a NGO pilot of the tool (Mar 2027-Feb 2028, G1 Mar 2028) and Stage 1b federal/state design-partner track co-producing artifacts (Jan-Dec 2027: 0400 Kit, Job-Analysis Starter Pack, PA-validated federal-to-state crosswalk, PA/TX/WA class crosswalks, USWFS-USFS fire crosswalk); charter sequence interpreted (tool piloted first; partners are shadow users); no selection use before selection-grade evidence; fast track limited to translation/crediting.
dissent_summary: Strict-sequence option (cleaner learning, less federal risk) rejected; IO wary of adopter-recruited panels. Window dates corrected by V1/V3 (OPM consolidation proposed; NRM Tier 2 undated; fire alignment USWFS-USFS not NWCG); charter interpretation flagged to project lead.

title: Lifecycle states, watch pre-state, protect overlay, use tiers
decision_summary: Editorial status and lifecycle state are separate; FS lifecycle (watch in L5 only -> proposed -> emerging -> established -> declining -> withdrawn; lapsed/merged) with FS evidence thresholds and review-by dates on L1-L4 incl. tasks and tools (DC L4 states mapped); stored protect overlay (2-of-3 criteria; Editorial Board decides; Tribal items need Tribal Council); use tiers exploratory/describe/develop/select with effective tier = min(lifecycle cap, IO evidence, reliability gate).
dissent_summary: IO may want training uses of emerging content gated by validation (CA allows develop use, bars select); LM prefers posting thresholds throughout (used for established only).

title: DEI/EJ-labelled content for federal adopters
decision_summary: Keep content that meets the evidence standard; name every competency by the work performed under a uniform rule (programme labels become aliases); compute venue/federal applicability from sensitivity edges to dated L5 instruments so federal default profiles exclude items with no current federal basis while state/local/NGO/private views keep them; Tribal content never in DEI/EJ containers (5.3 split); nonpartisan posture.
dissent_summary: Renaming may read as capitulation (mitigated by uniform rule and aliases); FH preferred stored flags (made computed). Publication stance of federal default views confirmed by project lead.

title: Work functions, modes, workflow profiles, authority position, sign-off
decision_summary: 13 work functions on tasks (Assess & sense; Plan & design; Review consequences; Make rules & policy; Authorize incl. delegated programmes; Resource & finance; Build & implement; Operate & maintain; Monitor & verify incl. Report & attest; Inspect, enforce & assure; Respond & recover; Learn & adapt; Lead & manage) + 2 cross-cutting modes (Engage & communicate with G2G as distinct relationship type; Resolve & defend); 10 workflow profiles with v1 S1-S6 kept as WP-PROJECT; authority position (8 values) required on role variants; sign-off authority on tasks/variants linked to credentials; industry/ownership/delivery facets.
dissent_summary: Facet longer than CA draft (8 -> 13+2); SL wanted position as role-variant facet (adopted); WF-MANAGE is a CA addition not proposed by a role; IO to test agreement.

title: Subsectors, modules, wave 1
decision_summary: DB's 44 subsectors in 9 clusters (L0, polyhierarchical); cluster X is core practice; 19 modules (DB's 18 + MOD-18 laboratory) with namespaces; wave 1 = MOD-01, -02, -03, -04, -06, -09, v1-seeded -11 and -12, plus MOD-15 pulled forward; IA's 7 public-lands gap functions go to MOD-11/-15/-07a (not core); water ops and EH services are centrally commissioned modules; home-module rule (one home = regime governing legal sufficiency) plus three-module core rule; species ID, GHG inventories and Section 106 review are core.
dissent_summary: DB placed parks in wave 3 (moved to wave 1 for 0025/NPS coverage); PS may weigh ESG higher (full module wave 3, core disclosure competencies wave 1); steward readiness [J] partly verified by V3.

title: NLP linking target
decision_summary: Link text to full competency documents now (best task recorded as evidencesTask); DP-18a switch to tasks per role family when L2 has 15-30 O*NET-crosswalked tasks per role and task-level linking beats competency-level by >=0.10 P@1 with non-overlapping CIs and noise abstention >=0.7; human review default; acceptance rule for method changes; no uncorrected top-1 counts; 600-item double-annotated gold set (>=40% non-public-lands); thresholds by use (selection: two reviewers, >=close).
dissent_summary: CA's task-spine lean wanted tasks sooner (IA evidence wins on timing); LLM rerank costs and provider dependence.

title: v1 task sequence v7 and WFIC-1 gate
decision_summary: v7 retires as governance instrument (archived). WFIC-1 gate resolved: no WFIC-2/3, no F16; fire intelligence becomes L3 role family R08 (emerging, MOD-11, COR-2) composed from tasks incl. FS-C05; WFIC becomes a horizon-scanning channel. Pending tasks: Pre-15A closed as executed; Pre-15B superseded by re-rating against v2 text (widened to D1/D2); 15 retired as column population (lenses as rubric/facet/checklist, alpha gate); 15.5 and 16 retired (modules/facets; robustness class; LM crosswalks); 16.5 closed by Phase 1; 17-19 retired/superseded (static explorer, DE pipeline; v1 not published as standard); 20-21 redesigned under IO Delphi; 22 carried into FS/AS sentinel network.
dissent_summary: No role argued for F16; trade-off is continuity for v7 readers expecting 222+n and an F16 page. EO 14308 WFIC claim not re-verified.

title: Layers, entity catalogue, stored vs computed (new)
decision_summary: Layers L0 vocabularies (incl. scenario set, driver mechanisms), L1 competencies/indicators/enactments, L2 tasks/knowledge, L3 roles/variants/families/pathways, L4 tools/methods/standards, L5 assessments/signals/instrument registry + driver events/watch items/frictions, L6 crosswalks + credential/series/state-class registers; store atoms (text, per-rater ratings with text hash, links, events, mappings, decisions), compute every summary by versioned rules; schema forbids stored summaries.
dissent_summary: DE notes source files are less self-contained (mitigated by shipping computed views).

title: Crosswalk programme and credentials (new)
decision_summary: SSSOM 1.0 mapping sets per upstream version (IDs only) for: v1->v2; EMST task->O*NET 31.0 task/DWA (two coders, kappa>=0.6; plus 27.x for Eloundou); role variant->O*NET-SOC 2019/SOC 2018 (fix verified errors; SOC 2028 re-map); OPM series register with proposed-realignment statuses; state class records (SL 28 fields); CIP/accreditation; ESCO 1.2.1; private reference job architecture; FWCI; credential<->CLO equivalence; public-private translation. Credential is a first-class reference entity linked as gates and sign-off authority, never proficiency; DB register seeded with V3 corrections. No alignment claims before reviewed sets exist.
dissent_summary: SSSOM heavier for HR users (flat CSV shipped); class-level state crosswalks with pilot-only position overrides; credential register rows unverified until checked.

title: Mobility model, frictions, theory of change, expansion gates (new)
decision_summary: Adopt CM's restated theory of change (visibility in gate instruments + reduced frictions on demand-backed pathways) as operating version, charter as north star; similarity = importance-weighted asymmetric task overlap shown as directional coverage; pathway score = similarity x (1-friction) x demand; first-class friction register (CM owner); recommendation gated on M-03 (AUC>=0.70), exploratory until then; displacement aggregates as first validation data; gates G1/G2 adopted with AS additions; artifact registry; families navigation-only.
dissent_summary: Narrower promise than charter wording (flagged to project lead); craft blends not the mobility engine; honest pay-direction messaging less attractive for adoption.

title: Validation regime and release criteria (new)
decision_summary: v2.0 is describe/develop-grade with use tiers and validation status on every element; selection-grade per function cluster after job analysis and linkage; IO minimum-evidence-by-use table as release criteria; Krippendorff alpha gates on CI lower bound (>=.80 production, .667-.80 tentative, <.667 not shown); LLM tagging only behind IO gate, never sole coder for selection values; pre-registered modified Delphi on OSF; contraction-bias composition correction; tasks-first matrix-sampled survey; first clusters: field monitoring, compliance/permitting/review, geospatial/data, water quality and operations, natural-resources Starter Pack series. Selection-grade validation is framed by the SIOP Principles, AERA/APA/NCME Standards, Chance to Compete Act job-relatedness and Title VII defensibility, not "UGESP compliance" (V4: DOJ opinion Jun 9 2026; OPM IFR Jul 31 2026; OFCCP rescission effective Oct 26 2026).
dissent_summary: Product pressure to publish everything at v2.0 rejected for a smaller use-labelled release; selection-grade content arrives after the first design-partner year.

title: Transversal layer and responsible-AI split (new)
decision_summary: Core transversal layer in six clusters (data and AI floor; integrity and accountability; safety culture; formation of others and knowledge continuity; systems and collaboration; professional services and funding); every role carries L1 on data literacy, responsible AI use and AI-output validation; responsible AI in three layers (floor, DC specialist competencies, FC/DC/SC enactments); SC-C05 merges into the SC enactment and SC-C02 with legal-adequacy anchors kept; DC steward of record, SC co-owns authorization, IO validates; D7 dispositions (7.1.1 held); horizon scanning is a core practice, not transversal.
dissent_summary: DC: not all responsible-AI content is transversal (three layers adopted); SC accepts SC-C05 merge only with legal-adequacy anchors; CM: D7 bridging not evidence of portability yet.

title: Learning layer (new)
decision_summary: CLOs (2-5 anchored indicators per competency x level, each with an IRI) published inside L1; instructional examples a separate labelled layer; L1-L3 trainable, L4-L5 recognized by evidence; credential bundles = computed versioned views of 3-8 CLOs aligned via OB 3.0/CLR 2.0 with currency by change velocity; pathway registry from role deltas (LC-PW-06 and -01 first, then CM bridge kits); learning-design attributes; formation rules R6/R7 normative-provisional; evidence-equivalence register; SAF EPRC recognition sought only after v2.1.
dissent_summary: Efficiency vs formation (pay the mentor-time cost for formation tasks only, measure it); simulation does not replace field exposure (FC); tool modules as expiring learning objects (DC/PS).

title: Product scope, display policy, claims hygiene, sector-facing package (new)
decision_summary: v2.0 = Role Change & Development Planner (role change; local-first gap check; exploratory pathways; what's-coming view) + generated Federal Series/State Class views, kits first; PD skeleton in v2.0, full builder in v2.1; v1 exposure values only in a labelled task-level evidence drawer, never aggregated or default; every number tier- and denominator-labelled; retire v1 public claims; corrected-facts list; WCAG 2.2 AA and ACR as release gates (CP signs in Phase 4, Steward after); package = flagship report, deck, explorer, role-change briefs.
dissent_summary: CP wanted v1 values visible at task level by default (moved to evidence drawer per IO alpha rule); FS what's-coming view risks speculation (labelled). Publication of v1-derived figures is the project lead's decision.

title: Change-signal layer and horizon scanning (new)
decision_summary: ChangeSignal schema (LM+IA+FS fields incl. linker quality, driver tags, reliability, CARE/personal-data flags); two-family, two-period, close-match, driver-tagged, human-reviewed evidence rule to move role change indicators (else watch); instrument registry + dated driver events + 16 L0 mechanisms with sensitivity edges replace reform flags (seeded from SC/V2, TN under gate, FC, SL, FH, modules); state HR events are policy-family signals; plan signals weighted per plan; quarterly registry refresh; FS horizon-scanning cadence and decision rights; 60-90 stratified paid sentinels; year-five floor.
dissent_summary: SC: instrument layer needs a named owner (assigned); LM vs FS on false positives vs late detection (watch/lapsed/reviewBy); Tribal channel only on Tribal terms.

title: Phase 4 integration rulings on S0-S1 change requests (new; CA)
decision_summary: Rules on CR-DE-001..003, CR-IO-001..003, CR-LM-001..003, CR-IA-001..002: SPEC corrected to 2.0.0-draft.2; schema-local enums moved into the existing 19 vocab files; DE extra fields ratified (v1Seed stripped from releases); stability tier not migrated (ADR-0011 rule 4/5 conflict resolved); vocab/rules/ is the computed-view rule home with 8 rule files; IO publication-rule tier mapping and display-gate semantics ratified; exposure ordinal order E0<E2<E1<E3; typed change-signal evidence fields with provider table; occupation-grain external-index assessments; WP-10 lane ratified. DE implements per change_requests/RULINGS_FOR_DE.md; role/variant seed-key convention and mvp_role_set errata; SSSOM 1.0 plus 1.1 LLMBasedMatching as declared extension.
dissent_summary: DE preferred new l5/l6 vocab files (rejected to keep the generator invariant); IO accepts that gating Task.workFunction thins View 1; LM accepts listing every active independence key.

title: SPEC field clashes, unstated paths, DE schema additions
decision_summary: Accept with changes: signalStatus/seriesStatus/sourceStatus; prefLabel not title; VocabularyTerm notation as base array; mint_id.py single writer (mint_ids.py alias); instruments.jsonl path; definition MUST on authored L0/L1/L3 records; seed-v1 exempt from type MUST fields and cannot become candidate; Task.tools[] and Competency.enactments[] computed inverses (the latter changed from core-only); schema-local enums moved into existing vocab files; DE additions ratified (v1Seed stripped from every release; v1Values, sWatch, tacitExperienceRequirement; v1-only competency-subject ratings; obs4Flags, evidencePlan, safetyOrLegalCritical, distinguishingAttribute; transversalCluster; reviewBy; / in seed keys).
dissent_summary: DE proposed new vocab files and core-only stored enactments; both changed.

title: Vocabulary gaps (ID prefixes, X12, yes/no quoting, state class enums, recovery flag)
decision_summary: Accept 1-4: WCH/SER/SCR prefixes and regex; X12 registered; formation_dependency quoted; supervisory_status and appointment_route machine values. Reject 5: no recovered flag (derivedFrom.relation=recovered already records it).
dissent_summary: None.

title: Stability tier and CLD in migration; computed-view rule home
decision_summary: Stability tier NOT migrated (rule-determined summary, zero violations; ADR-0011 rule 4 amended, rule 5 names it); reform flags and the competency-level CLD flag/R9 severity/S-trajectory migrate as prior evidence (CLD contradicts its rule in 11/222, so carries judgment). vocab/rules/<id>@<version>.yaml is the only rule home (schema/rules rejected); CA registered counts, inverse-links 1.0.0/1.1.0, assessment-staleness, effective-use-tier 0.1.0/1.0.0, change-indicator, display-gate.
dissent_summary: None.

title: Machine-checkable publication rules
decision_summary: Accept with changes: publicationRuleChecks pass|fail|pending|not-applicable with evidence MUST on PR-1/PR-4 pass (PUB-14); distinguishingAttribute required above the lowest level with indicators; IO tier mapping ratified (rc.1 levels describe-grade until a Delphi runs); waiver register at data/v2/governance/lint_waivers.csv (not registers/).
dissent_summary: None.

title: Display-gate semantics
decision_summary: Confirm items 1-7 with clarifications: unmeasured = Assessment pending; admissible study (human raters, >=120 units, >=3 raters floor with 6 as design target, bootstrap lower bound, pre-registered, blind, 36-month lapse; LLM only via coder gate plus change record, never for select); editorial list extended (sectorActorSubtype, Enactment.actorType, transversalCluster); Task.workFunction gated, views navigate by editorial role function; strata, weak categories, production/tentative, select views confirmed; registered as display-gate@1.0.0.
dissent_summary: IO: View 1 thinner until the first reliability study.

title: Exposure E-level order and scenario eligibility
decision_summary: Accept: ordinal_order [E0, E2, E1, E3] added, codes kept; ordinal alpha with nominal alongside; scenario rows apply at E1, E2 or E3 or compressive-plus or formation tasks. Eloundou weighting citation stays E-u pending WP-15.
dissent_summary: None.

title: Evidence-rule fields on ChangeSignal; L5 vocabulary gaps
decision_summary: Accept with changes: typed signalFamily (counts_toward; policy role-change only; projection/workload never), independenceKey slug with provider table in vocab (listed key required when active), registeredDeployment, impact, SP-01..SP-12 signposts (SP-12 Tribal Council only), pointsToward, measure baseline/sensitivity; EMST-* notation forbidden from candidate; occupation target rejected (attach via X3); organization target for government employers only, never Tribal (V3); statusAfter vocab with under-review; submitted-for-review event; agency-order instrument type; evidence rule ported to scripts/ and tests/; mvp-role targets excluded at release.
dissent_summary: LM: extra stewardship of independence keys.

title: Occupation-grain external-index assessments
decision_summary: Accept with changes: role target with crosswalk path when unit=occupation; levelDistribution with basis or index values only; externalSource unit/values/dispersion; partial assessedAt; LicenseRef-EMST-third-party-index-derived excluded from every bundle until terms verified; context-only display, broad-match values in evidence drawer only; promote only after DE schema change.
dissent_summary: None.

title: WP-10 write lane vs authoring-guide layout
decision_summary: Accept: WP-10 lane = signals, instruments, events, core/watch-items, assessments/external, docs/methods; builder stays LM authoring tool (deterministic, in-lane, never run by CI or build); evidence rule moves to DE lane.
dissent_summary: None.

title: Role/variant seed keys; mvp_role_set errata
decision_summary: Accept with one wording change: RoleProfile seed:<role_key>, RoleVariant seed:<role_key>/<sector_actor>[/<slice>]; errata applied to mvp_role_set.csv per V1-10 (0408/0482/0486 not proposed for realignment; 0410 proposed->0401; R19 O*NET 19-1031.00); R09 worded "0408/0486/0482 not proposed" rather than "none proposed" (0462 unchecked).
dissent_summary: None.

title: SSSOM 1.0 conformance vs semapv:LLMBasedMatching
decision_summary: Accept: keep LLMBasedMatching on unreviewed agent rows; acceptance = SSSOM 1.0 with the 1.1 justification as declared extension, re-validated at 1.1 final; reviewed rows take MappingReview and keep original_justification in other; optional strict-1.0 export rendering.
dissent_summary: None.

title: S1 close: rulings on S1 content CRs, two S2 CRs and the S1 integration review (new; CA)
decision_summary: Rules on CR-DB-001, CR-DC-001, CR-DE-004, CR-FC-001, CR-FC-002, CR-LC-001, CR-SC-001 and the mid-session CR-CP-001, CR-FH-001 (every CR now ruled): typed instrument links (requires/enables/constrains/removed-requirement) with venue-applicability@1.0.0 counting only requires (fixes SL-C02 federal reading a rescission as basis); task edges store only task-specific additions; Competency.mirrors on the authority side (inverse-links@1.2.0); three-module CI check with exception register, zero enactments passes; Enactment.subsectors; planned role/candidate references; typed Pathway formation provisions, cloOutcomes, emstRelease; derived CLO IRI; employer-mandated closure type; case-sensitive productExamples. Integration review: core projection 180 (169 + 11 held), at the G-9 ceiling; five merges of unauthored v1 seeds -> 175; no cross-lane duplicate competencies (SL-C07/SL-C03 overlap fixed in module); Tribal hold held (104 held records excluded; one X1 comment redaction). S2 work orders assign cross-lane content and 21 unauthored core rows; S1 builders frozen. SPEC 2.0.0-draft.3; DE implements per RULINGS_FOR_DE.md Batch 2. Role-bundle values split into editorial design values (membership, role levels, formationTask, target levels; shown labelled) and gated job-analysis values (importance, time share, critical, needed-at-entry; display-gate@1.1.0); six view rules registered (federal-series-profile, state-class-view, job-family-membership, role-change, mirror-links, pathway-edges); views read released records only.
dissent_summary: SC: inherited task edges only in a computed view; DB: DB-C53 stays wave-2 module; LC: responses[] array less strict; FS/CM: FS-C15 and CC-CM-02 not merged. CP/FH: no time shares in View 1 or HR kits before job analysis.

title: Three-module CI check, Enactment subsectors, DB-C53 home, cross-module drafts, wildlife harvest
decision_summary: Accept 1, 2, 4: W/E-THREE-MODULE on 1-2 module enactments (zero passes; recurrence reported as I-THREE-MODULE-RECURRENCE), exception register data/v2/governance/three_module_exceptions.yaml (empty); Enactment.subsectors with E-MODULE-SUBSECTOR from candidate; module-to-module references confirmed. Decide 3: DB-C53 stays MOD-18 lab (wave 2), data-user part in core FC-C24 and a lab-data review task in v1 2.2.3 (ADR-0018 §2 amended). Decide 5: module candidate DB-C56 harvest management (MOD-12). Route 6 to LM, 7 to LC.
